subject: MyBinder free hosting for Jupyter via Docker

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: MyBinder free hosting for Jupyter via Docker
parts:
This might work for the Cloud Stan (formerly known as
the Stan box).

Matthew McKay of the QuantEcon project at (university
that shall not be named) pointed me at this:

http://mybinder.org/

Looks like they provide hosting for Jupyter.

I just love that their site tells you what the hell
they do in the very first line:

Turn a GitHub repo into a collection of interactive
notebooks powered by Jupyter and Kubernetes.
...
100% free and open source

You can include a Dockerfile to run. It appears to be
limited to Python.

I haven't tried it.

- Bob
